overview_description.description: Mnzil is a tech-enabled workforce services platform on a mission to improve workers’ lives through better living, mobility, and integrated services. By seamlessly integrating accommodation, transportation, financial, and essential services, Mnzil provides every worker with a safe, dignified place to live, rest, and belong. Guided by the belief that better living makes better work, Mnzil is redefining the future of workforce services through technology and operational excellence.
